summary: Implemented and executed new P0 frontend/backend test suites, updated obsolete backend suites to current local-first contracts, and reran all relevant backend suites with exact counts.

critical.issue: HEAD405->GET fallback path is not implemented; unit test captured only GET (no HEAD preflight).
Reusing evidence_id with changed binding is rejected as 422 validation error, not expected conflict semantics (409) in P0 fixture flow.

integration_issues.issue: Regression reproduced: enqueueing an older acknowledged payload can replace a newer pending payload for same event key.

integration_issues.flow: Mobile web payload capture via deep routes
integration_issues.issue: Onboarding/setup redirects prevented stable end-to-end capture of message/email/account outbound JSON in one deterministic run.

action_items: Implement/confirm outbound HEAD preflight fallback logic (HEAD 405 -> GET) or align test/contract explicitly.
Align patrol evidence-id changed-binding response contract (expected 409 conflict vs current 422).
Fix deliveryQueue stale-version re-enqueue behavior so older acknowledged payload cannot overwrite newer pending payload.
Add deterministic setup-bypass fixture/state for mobile web payload-capture UI tests to avoid onboarding redirect interference.
critical_code_review_comments: Queue version monotonicity invariant still breaks under older payload replay while newer pending exists.
Transport public_get does not currently demonstrate HEAD preflight + 405 fallback pathway.
Many suites previously hardcoded fallback URLs and outdated expectations; updated to env-driven local-first 403 contract while preserving negative assertions.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral registered devices and patrol events during live API tests; no persistent seeded fixtures committed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-P0 coverage matrix: P0-01 outbound hardened transport tests added and run (1 fail: HEAD405 fallback); P0-02 delivery queue durability/version tests added and run (1 fail: stale-version overwrite); P0-03 truth/privacy/file tests added and run (all pass); P0-04 mapper->payload->egress->live patrol E2E fixture added and run (1 fail: changed-binding expected 409 got 422); P0-05 obsolete backend suites migrated to disabled-403/minimal-sentinel contracts and rerun (pass); P0-06 focused payload/lifecycle browser checks attempted with mobile viewport; onboarding redirects prevented deterministic full capture in final run.
rca_of_issue: RCA 1: deliveryQueue enqueue currently allows overwrite when pending exists with different version, enabling older acknowledged payload replay to replace newer pending. RCA 2: outbound.public_get currently calls public_stream with GET directly and does not exhibit HEAD preflight fallback behavior. RCA 3: changed evidence-id binding path is rejected by packet-backed invariant before conflict-type handling, yielding 422 instead of desired 409 semantics.
